name: Two line charts compared
what: Two small chart frames stacked on a dark page: a glowing line is drawn left to right in each - flat in the top one, rising exponentially in the bottom one - then a glowing name is typed over each chart.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0 the two charts' axes are there; f4-f58 the top line is drawn left to right (slow start, quick middle, long soft finish) and f4-f46 the bottom one (a little faster), each with a bright thicker trail behind its tip that thins out; f46-f64 both names are typed at the same time, a character every 3.5 f, each letter glowing; then it holds to the end

tracks.name: top line
tracks.what: the top line is drawn from left to right with a bright trail behind its tip
tracks.easing: S-curve, slow start, long soft finish (measured)

tracks.name: bottom line
tracks.what: the bottom line is drawn from left to right, a little faster

tracks.name: names
tracks.what: both names are typed together, one character every 3.5 f, each letter glowing
